title: HNSCC_multiomics_pipeline parameters
description: Multi-omics circRNA/HPV profiling pipeline for paired tumor/normal HNSCC samples

samplesheet.description: Path to master sample sheet (see assets/samplesheet_template.csv for format).

rnaseq_results.description: Output directory of the Stage 1a nf-core/rnaseq (v3.26.0) run.

sarek_results.description: Output directory of the Stage 1b nf-core/sarek (v3.9.0) run.

smrnaseq_results.description: Output directory of the Stage 1c nf-core/smrnaseq run (version pin TBD, open item #19).

outdir.description: Directory to write pipeline results to.

hpv_panel_fasta.description: High-risk HPV genotype reference panel FASTA (see download_references.sh).

circrna_annotation.description: Pinned circAtlas hg38 release (known/novel reference). Required whenever the circRNA arm runs (open item #16).

circrna_tools.description: Comma-separated detection ensemble. Drop entries to disable a caller (CI / ablation). Without 'ciriquant' the count matrix and DESeq2 steps are skipped.

star_index.description: Prebuilt STAR index; built from fasta/gtf if unset.

bwa_index.description: Prebuilt BWA index; built from fasta if unset.

bowtie2_index.description: Prebuilt Bowtie2 index; built from fasta if unset.

ciriquant_index.description: Prebuilt CIRIquant reference bundle (config.yaml + hisat2/bwa indices); built if unset.

star_chimeric_args.description: STAR chimeric-detection flags for the shared alignment. Keep in sync with the Stage 1a nf-core/rnaseq --extra_star_align_args (open items #10, #23).

trimgalore_args.description: Extra flags passed to Trim Galore.

circrna_bsj_min_reads.description: Minimum back-splice-junction read support per tool before the consensus merge (decision 6).

circrna_min_tools.description: Minimum number of tools that must call a BSJ for it to enter the quantified DE matrix. The annotated registry keeps all >=1-tool calls (decision 7).

circrna_bsj_merge_slop.description: Coordinate margin (bp) for matching BSJs across tools; canonical junctions still match exactly (decision 8).

circrna_deseq2_sizefactors.description: DESeq2 size-factor method for the sparse circRNA matrix. Placeholder pending batch-1 data (open item #20): 'poscounts' | 'ratio' | 'import:<file>'.

circrna_min_expr_reads.description: Low-count prefilter: reads required to count a circRNA as detected in a sample (decision 19).

circrna_min_expr_samples_frac.description: Low-count prefilter: fraction of samples in at least one tissue group in which a circRNA must be detected to be tested (decision 19).
